iterations.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginRequest" name="Login credentials"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginSuccess" name="Login successful"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginFailure" name="Login unsuccessful"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderSubmission" name="Order submission"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StepsComplete" name="Address and payment steps complete"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OnlineShop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_EShop" name="E-Shop system" processRef="Process_EShop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank" processRef="Process_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginRequest" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Start_LoginRequest" messageRef="Message_LoginRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginSuccess" sourceRef="Event_LoginSuccess" targetRef="Event_CustomerLoginSuccess" messageRef="Message_LoginSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginFailure" sourceRef="Event_LoginFailure" targetRef="Event_CustomerLoginFailure" messageRef="Message_LoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderSubmission" sourceRef="Task_SubmitOrder" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrder" messageRef="Message_OrderSubmission"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentData" sourceRef="Task_EnterPaymentData" targetRef="Start_PaymentData" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentConfirmation" sourceRef="Event_BankPaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Event_CustomerPaymentConfirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StepsComplete" sourceRef="Task_NotifyStepsComplete" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStepsComplete" messageRef="Message_StepsComplete"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ordering" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Begin shopping"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Login" name="Log in and submit credentials"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForLogin" name="Wait for login confirmation" eventGatewayType="Exclusive" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CustomerLoginSuccess" name="Login successful">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerLoginSuccess" messageRef="Message_LoginSuccess"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CustomerLoginFailure" name="Login unsuccessful">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerLoginFailure" messageRef="Message_LoginFailure"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginFailure" name="Shopping stops"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Select a product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckProducts" name="Check whether all products have been selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" name="All products selected?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_ProductLoop"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitOrder" name="Submit order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CustomerParallelSplit" name="Enter payment and address details" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterPaymentData" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CustomerPaymentConfirmation" name="Wait for bank payment confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerPaymentConfirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterShippingAddress" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingAddressCheck" name="Shipping address differs from billing address?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_NoSeparateBilling"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBillingAddress" name="Enter independent billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge" name="Continue after address entry" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CustomerParallelJoin" name="Payment and address steps complete" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyStepsComplete" name="Notify system that payment and address steps are complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Customer steps complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerStartLogin" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginWait" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForLogin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitLoginSuccess" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForLogin" targetRef="Event_CustomerLoginSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitLoginFailure" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForLogin" targetRef="Event_CustomerLoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginSuccessSelect" sourceRef="Event_CustomerLoginSuccess" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginFailureEnd" sourceRef="Event_CustomerLoginFailure" targetRef="End_LoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectAdd" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddSave" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SaveCheck" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckProducts" targetRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllProductsDone" name="All products selected" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_SubmitOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allProductsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProductLoop" name="More products to select" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitParallel" sourceRef="Task_SubmitOrder" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelAddress" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentWaitConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_EnterPaymentData" targetRef="Event_CustomerPaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentJoin" sourceRef="Event_CustomerPaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShippingBillingCheck" sourceRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddressCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SeparateBilling" name="Addresses differ" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressCheck" targetRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">shippingAddressDiffersFromBillingAddress</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSeparateBilling" name="Addresses do not differ" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressCheck" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingEntered" sourceRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddressJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressMerge" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelNotify" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_NotifyStepsComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyEnd" sourceRef="Task_NotifyStepsComplete" targetRef="End_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EShop" name="E-Shop order processing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_LoginRequest" name="Receive login credentials">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LoginRequest" messageRef="Message_LoginRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check credentials"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CredentialsValid" name="Credentials valid?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_CredentialsInvalid"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Event_LoginSuccess" name="Send successful login confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LoginSuccess" messageRef="Message_LoginSuccess"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Event_LoginFailure" name="Send unsuccessful login confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LoginFailure" messageRef="Message_LoginFailure"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginFailure" name="Login unsuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOrder" name="Receive order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishInitialOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare payment and shipment" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Payment and shipment prepared" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveStepsComplete" name="Receive confirmation that payment and address steps are complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishFinalOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EShop" name="Order finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginCheck" sourceRef="Start_LoginRequest" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckCredentialsGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Gateway_CredentialsValid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CredentialsValid" name="Credentials valid" sourceRef="Gateway_CredentialsValid" targetRef="Event_LoginSuccess">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">credentialsValid</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CredentialsInvalid" name="Credentials invalid" sourceRef="Gateway_CredentialsValid" targetRef="Event_LoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginFailureEnd" sourceRef="Event_LoginFailure" targetRef="End_LoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginSuccessReceiveOrder" sourceRef="Event_LoginSuccess" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveInitialFinish" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOrder" targetRef="Task_FinishInitialOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialFinishSplit" sourceRef="Task_FinishInitialOrder" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparePayment" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareShipment" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentPreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShipmentPreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationReceiveCompletion" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStepsComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompletionFinish" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStepsComplete" targetRef="Task_FinishFinalOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalFinishEnd" sourceRef="Task_FinishFinalOrder" targetRef="End_EShop"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Bank" name="Bank payment confirmation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PaymentData" name="Receive payment data">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PaymentData" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmPayment" name="Confirm payment"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_BankPaymentConfirmation" name="Send payment confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BankPaymentConfirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankStartConfirm" sourceRef="Start_PaymentData" targetRef="Task_ConfirmPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankConfirmEnd" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmPayment" targetRef="Event_BankPaymentConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
